# `material`

What elements are made of: density, toughness and resistances (02 §5.4).

The engine supplies `engine:none`, which may be named bare (04 §4.4).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `density` (a density as a number in SI units or a string with a unit; **required**): Mass per volume.
- `toughness` (an energy per volume as a number in SI units or a string with a unit; **required**): Energy to destroy one cubic metre.
- `resist` (object, name → object [`ResistSpec`](#resistspec); optional): Resistance by damage type id.
- `span` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): How many cells an element of this material can reach sideways from support.
- `bearing` (a pressure as a number in SI units or a string with a unit, or `null`; optional): The stress it can carry in compression before it is crushed. Absent means it is never crushed.
- `flammable` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether it is fuel for fire.
- `rubble` (string, or `null`; optional): The fixture destroyed elements of this material leave behind.
- `color` (string, or `null`; optional): A colour name, for presentation.
- `tags` (list of string; optional): Free-form tags.
- `leak` (object [`LeakSpec`](#leakspec), or `null`; optional): As tissue (06 §6.1): what a breached layer of this material drains. Read by the body model; the world gives it no meaning.
- `signal` (object [`SignalSpec`](#signalspec), or `null`; optional): As tissue (06 §6.1): what a damaged layer of this material adds to a pool. Read by the body model.
- `heal` ([rate](../units.md#rate) in `/s`, or `null`; optional): As tissue (06 §6.1): the share of a layer of this material that recovers each second, unaided. Read by the body model.
- `friction` (number, or `null`; optional): How strongly a surface of this material holds back what slides over it: the coefficient of sliding friction (02 §15.3). Absent, a body slides over it by the engine's default.

<a id="resistspec"></a>
### `ResistSpec`

How a material or element resists one damage type (02 §5.4, §12.2).

- `threshold` (a pressure as a number in SI units or a string with a unit; **required**): Intensity below which the damage type does nothing.
- `factor` (number; optional): Multiplier on the energy that gets through. Default 1.

<a id="leakspec"></a>
### `LeakSpec`

What a breached layer of tissue drains (06 §6.1): a pool of the body it belongs to, by so much a second for each square metre of wound.

The pool is a definition of the simulation's, which the world cannot name: it is kept as written and resolved by the body model.

- `pool` (string; **required**): The pool drained, by id.
- `rate` (number; **required**): What is drained each second for each square metre of wound.
- `closes` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`, or `null`; optional): How long a breach leaks before it closes by itself. Left out, it leaks until something closes it.

<a id="signalspec"></a>
### `SignalSpec`

What damaged tissue adds to a pool of the body it belongs to (06 §6.1): so much for each joule the tissue absorbed.

- `pool` (string; **required**): The pool added to, by id.
- `per_joule` (number; **required**): What is added for each joule absorbed.
